deviations.what: The three organization forms each declare LocationField(full=False) and a clean_location, with no shared mixin and without LocationFormMixin.
deviations.why: An organization has no elevation or uncertainty, so the mixin's second job does not apply, and the brief asks for the point-only field used directly with no second mechanism.

concerns: Pre-existing tests changed, as the brief allows: test_profile.py TestOrganizationProfileForm (field set gains location) and test_update.py TestOrganizationUpdate (the page's control names gain location_first and location_second). Nothing else was edited.

AS 6.1 (ROR coordinates become the point) and the overview map condition were already satisfied and tested by earlier work (test_transforms.py TestRORRoundTrip, test_overview.py scenario 9), so this story added no new ROR or overview test. AS 6.4 had no test; TestPersonPlacedOnAMap is new and was probed by forcing as_geojson to return None, which made two of its three tests fail.
The widget names its inputs location_first and location_second (dict-keyed MultiWidget), not location_0 and location_1.

The ledger code references recorded for T030 name lines 277 of forms/profile.py and 63 of forms/organization.py, which are near but not exactly the declared field lines (345 and 48, 127). ledger-task cannot be re-run for the same task without duplicating the row, so they were left.
